reviewed_by: Codex focused review for paired-browser diagnostics CSRF
reason: Paired browser diagnostics POSTs received 403 because their sender omitted the device CSRF header. The selected logger tests cover the failed write, buffered retry, cookie decoding and same-origin credentials; API client tests guard the shared header reader. A production LAN paired-browser check is performed separately.
exclusions: No Python or native source changes. Existing broad mock-browser areas do not exercise the paired cookie against real Core, so unrelated Playwright suites are excluded. Physical-device testing is unavailable.
